newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks mildly weaker ahead of Jospin speech.
newsitem.headline: French stocks mildly weaker ahead of Jospin speech.

text.p: French stocks were lower in quiet early trading on Thursday ahead of new Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's keynote policy speech to parliatment scheduled to begin at 1300 GMT.
"The market's waiting for Jospin but also watching to see how Wall Street performs. The market's short on ideas for the moment," a trader said.
* CAC-40 index down 12.06 points, or 0.44 pct, at 2,739.68 at 0900 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures contract down 11 at 2,737
* LVMH extends loss, slipping 0.4 percent, after stepping up its fight against proposed merger partners Guinness and Grand Met.
* Appliance firm Moulinex up 3.4 percent at 147.90 after reporting first annual profit since 1991 on Wednesday evening. Group meets with analysts this morning.
* Metaleurop up 1.49 percent at 78.15 francs after reporting sharp improvement in first-half 1996/97 results.
* Alcatel active after announcing plan to form strategic alliance with Loral in multimedia satellite networks. Alcatel shares down 1.38 percent at 643 francs.
